name: New Jersey
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: New Jersey has four AVAs: Central Delaware Valley, Warren Hills, Outer Coastal Plain and Cape May Peninsula.
